capabilities: Draw fault trees with standard FTA symbols and OR/AND/voting gates via drag-and-drop
Compute exact failure probabilities, switching to ROBDD when events are shared across gates
Check top-event probability against ARP4761A per-flight-hour targets
Save projects as .fta.json files in a chosen vault folder
Export diagrams as SVG and PNG into the vault
extras: A standalone browser version with the same editor core and compatible .fta.json format exists; the roadmap lists unfinished features such as code-block rendering and minimal cut sets.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw fault tree diagrams or compute their failure probabilities, so safety analysis has to happen in outside tools.
summary: Fault tree (FTA) editor that draws, quantifies, and stores fault tree projects as .fta.json files inside the vault.
